## OPTIONAL: Some initial data viz exercises

Below are some initial data viz exercises as an additional material for this week. That is why it says **Optional**, there will be usual lab material in the next week's workshop in week 6, as before. ### Data viz with starwars

Let us start with some basics of data viz on the starwars data set.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
starwars_df <- starwars
```

To decide, how to create any data viz, this supplementary material can be very useful to explore different types with explanations, and R code examples. I will attach this material for our weekly readings as well; 

[From Data to Viz](https://www.data-to-viz.com/)

## Exercise 2.

Let us star with some small changes. 

Modify the following plot to change the color of all points to `"pink"`.
Initial code given as; 

```{r}
ggplot(starwars_df, 
       aes(x = height, y = mass, color = gender, size = birth_year)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue")
```

## Exercise 3

Now for the given visualization, 
Add labels for title, x and y axes, and size of points. Uncomment what you added before running the code, to see its effect. How  about creating the visualization without the labs() layer, what is the difference there ? 

```{r}
ggplot(starwars, 
       aes(x = height, y = mass, color = gender, size = birth_year)) +
  geom_point(color = "#30509C") +
  labs(
    #title = "___",
    #x = "___", 
    #y = "___",
    #___
    )
```
